title: 8: Jira Developer Workflow
subtitle: Follow a realistic Java developer ticket from sprint board through development, CI, QA, review, release tracking, and reporting.

steps.title: Review Student.java before starting the Jira ticket
steps.why: Jira ticket start cheyyadaniki mundu developer existing Student.java context ni IntelliJ lo quick ga review chestadu. Ticket requirement code structure tho ela connect avuthundo clarity vastundi.

steps.title: Open the active Jira sprint board
steps.why: Office day lo developer first active sprint board open chesi assigned work, current status mariyu team flow ni check chestadu.

steps.title: Open JAVA-101 Student API story
steps.why: Implementation start cheyyadaniki mundu story description, parent epic, priority, sprint mariyu dependencies ni issue panel lo review chestam.

steps.title: Assign JAVA-101 to the developer
steps.why: Ticket ni actively own chestunnappudu assignee ni Developer ga set chestam. Team ki evaru work chestunnaro clear ga kanipistundi.

steps.title: Move the story to IN PROGRESS
steps.why: Actual implementation start ayyaka work item status ni IN PROGRESS ki move chestam. Sprint board current work ni correct ga reflect chestundi.

steps.title: Set the delivery due date
steps.why: Target delivery date ni ticket lo record chesthe sprint planning mariyu release coordination easy avuthayi.

steps.title: Add the original and remaining estimate
steps.why: Work effort track cheyyadaniki original estimate mariyu remaining estimate set chestam. Sprint capacity discussion lo ee values useful.

steps.title: Log the first hour of development work
steps.why: Implementation meeda spend chesina time ni Jira worklog lo record chestam. Remaining estimate kuda update chesthe progress realistic ga track avuthundi.

steps.title: Add a progress comment
steps.why: Team members ki context ivvadaniki concise progress comment add chestam. Stand-up leka handoff mundu ticket history useful ga untundi.

data.author: Developer
data.text: Student model and database contract verified. Starting endpoint implementation.

steps.title: Create the feature branch from the Jira story
steps.why: Jira key branch name lo include chesthe code changes ticket tho traceable ga untayi. Branch, commit, PR development panel lo connect avuthayi.

steps.title: Link the implementation commit
steps.why: Commit ni Jira story tho link chesthe requirement nundi exact code change varaku traceability maintain avuthundi.

steps.title: Link the pull request
steps.why: Code review status ni Jira nundi choodadaniki pull request ni story tho link chestam. Developer workflow ticket nundi Git review varaku continuous ga untundi.

steps.title: Record the successful CI build
steps.why: Pull request build green ga undha ani Jira development information lo surface chestam. Review mundu automated validation pass ayyindha ani team verify cheyyachu.

steps.title: Record the QA deployment
steps.why: Build QA environment ki deploy ayyaka deployment status ticket tho link chestam. Code complete nundi test environment varaku lifecycle visible ga untundi.

steps.title: Assign the story to release 1.2.0
steps.why: Fix Version set chesthe JAVA-101 release scope lo officially include avuthundi. Release page progress ticket statuses nundi calculate avuthundi.

steps.title: Review linked development activity
steps.why: Development view lo branch, commit, pull request, build mariyu deployment counts oka place lo verify chestam.

steps.title: Search the developer's release work with JQL
steps.why: JQL use chesi current user ki assign ayina 1.2.0 release work ni filter chestam. Real Jira lo focused triage kosam advanced search common.

data.jql: project = JAVA AND fixVersion = "1.2.0" AND assignee = currentUser() ORDER BY key ASC

steps.title: Review the sprint backlog
steps.why: Implementation progress madhyalo backlog open chesi current sprint mariyu future sprint work separation ni verify chestam.

steps.title: Create a review automation rule
steps.why: Repetitive status transitions automate cheyyadaniki Jira Automation rule create chestam. CI or PR event taruvatha review status update avvadam common team pattern.

steps.title: Run the automation and move JAVA-101 to CODE REVIEW
steps.why: Successful CI signal taruvatha automation rule story ni CODE REVIEW ki move chestundi. Manual status maintenance thaggutundi.

steps.title: Open JAVA-101 after automated transition
steps.why: Automation correct ga work ayyindha ani issue ni malli open chesi status, development links mariyu worklog context verify chestam.

steps.title: Complete JAVA-101 after review
steps.why: Review approve ayyaka story ni DONE ki transition chestam. Sprint metrics mariyu release progress automatically updated state ni use chestayi.

steps.title: Review release 1.2.0 progress
steps.why: Releases view lo 1.2.0 scope lo unna work items mariyu completed count ni inspect chestam. Ticket completion release planning tho connect avuthundi.

steps.title: Open the Jira team dashboard
steps.why: Dashboard gadgets assigned work, sprint health, created-versus-resolved mariyu activity ni quick team summary ga chupistayi.

steps.title: Inspect the sprint burndown report
steps.why: Sprint end ki progress trend ni check cheyyadaniki burndown report use chestam. Remaining work and scope health ni quick ga assess cheyyachu.

steps.title: Return to Student.java after Jira workflow completion
steps.why: Ticket workflow complete ayyaka developer malli IntelliJ ki return avuthadu. Jira, Git-style development data, release tracking mariyu code timeline continuous ga preserve avuthayi.
